environment.description: ECS Fargate service in us-west-2 VPC. ALB has a listener rule at priority 1 with a condition of type 'source-ip' matching CIDR blocks [10.200.0.0/16, 172.20.0.0/14, 192.168.100.0/24] (internal transit gateway ranges and VPN egress pool). A second rule at priority 2 returns fixed-response 403 for all other source IPs. The ALB security group references a prefix list (pl-0a1b2c3d4e5f) that resolves to the same three CIDR blocks. Note: the container itself has no network policy or application-layer IP check — the restriction is purely at the ALB listener rule evaluation layer before traffic reaches the target group.

config.vpc_endpoints: none - egress only via NAT gateway
